header:
Lehigh University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Two letters suffice under both departmental and CAS public checklists.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s degree with GPA normally at least 3.0; preparation should include abstract algebra, linear algebra,
real analysis and complex variables. A UChicago math bachelor’s student can apply for direct doctoral study;
degree completion and individual preparation must be verified. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare two referees, CV, personal statement and transcripts; use the CAS online application. Send referee
requests early. Check the linked 2027 CAS language policy and claim the US-study exemption with supporting
records. No extra application is required for departmental funding. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor commitment is listed. Research interests can be discussed with the faculty below; inquiries
go to inmathgr@lehigh.edu. [s1] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online CAS application; recommendations may be requested before submission. Post-submission application
updates should go to incasgrd@lehigh.edu. [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
CAS explicitly confirms 2027/2028 General GRE optional policy and links a 2027 English PDF; mathematics
deadlines remain standing undated rules. [s1] [s2] [s15]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Mathematics specifies January 1 for PhD applications, aligning with CAS January 1 financial-aid consideration.
Year/time zone are not stated. CAS June 30 without aid is a general deadline and should not replace
mathematics January 1. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Aim for all materials by January 1. Central application help says CAS supporting items usually may follow by 1-2
weeks, varying by program; this is not a confirmed mathematics grace period. Obtain written confirmation
before relying on late letters or scores. [s1] [s5]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Unresolved]
English proficiency is required unless exempt. Tests must remain valid through I-20 processing; submit an
unofficial score report or test documentation, not merely typed scores, with official results after admission. PTE
is accepted beginning 2027. CAS links a 2027 PDF for exact minimums; its content did not render publicly in
this review, so thresholds remain unresolved. [s3] [s4] [s15]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
The university exemption covers a degree earned by enrollment at a US institution with at least two
consecutive years of in-person study; a separate route covers two consecutive years of English-country
study/work in the preceding five years. Your UChicago degree therefore appears eligible if those duration/mode
conditions hold, including pending conferral before enrollment. This is an inference from the published
conditions, subject to CAS review. [s4]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional for 2027 and 2028 CAS applicants except History. Mathematics FAQ recommends General GRE, so
optional does not mean irrelevant. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Mathematics FAQ says a subject score can help, but is less important than General GRE; it is not required. [s1]

sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two recommendations required. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Mathematics expressly states no additional requirements to be considered for departmental financial support.
No extra scholarship reference is identified; distinct external award requirements are not established. [s1]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations are sent as soon as you click Send Request, which can occur before application submission. It is not
a submit-only invitation system. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Central application instructions discuss confirmation and recommender support, but explicit individual
letter-receipt display was not verified. Check the portal or contact CAS. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Recommenders can be changed before submission; after submission contact the department. Resend help is
available through graduate admissions or incasgrd@lehigh.edu. Replacement of an already submitted letter
and reuse across cycles are not established. [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Mathematics assistantships/fellowships include stipend and tuition remission. University minimum for a full
academic TA/RA/GA appointment is US $2,380 per month, effective August 2026-July 2027. This is a university
floor, not a verified mathematics annual offer; paid months, summer support and Fall 2027 rates are
unconfirmed. [s1] [s6]
Years of support; International eligibility [Unresolved]
A funded mathematics offer’s international eligibility and renewal-year guarantee are not explicit in the
checked public FAQ; confirm the actual assistantship contract, summer support and spoken-English teaching
obligations. [s1] [s2]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Departmental teaching/research assistantships and fellowships are available. CAS estimates 2026-27 annual
technology and wellness fees of $250 and $630, and health insurance $2,860 with possible 80% subsidy; verify
which charges the offer covers. [s1] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Mathematics expressly states no additional requirements to be considered for departmental financial support.
No extra scholarship reference is identified; distinct external award requirements are not established. [s1]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Department lists teaching/research assistantships and fellowships; award amounts and individual
external-scholarship international eligibility were not established. [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
US $50 nonrefundable application fee. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
CAS advertises limited fee-waiver opportunities through its inquiry/news communications. No automatic
hardship or international waiver entitlement is stated; request guidance before submission/payment. [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Andrew Harder
Hodge theory, Calabi-Yau varieties, mirror symmetry, holomorphic symplectic geometry and periods. [s7] [s8]
[s9]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · The Diagonal and Hadamard Grade of Hypergeometric Functions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory
Joe Kramer-Miller
Arithmetic differential equations, algebraic power series and periods; joint recent work studies
diagonal/Hadamard grades of hypergeometric functions. [s7] [s9]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · The Diagonal and Hadamard Grade of Hypergeometric Functions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Complex geometry
Terry Napier
Levi problem, Kähler manifolds, holomorphic mappings and potential theory. Official publication list stops at
2019; newer paper metadata was not verified. [s7] [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2019; latest in checked official list · Weakly special filtered ends of complete Kähler manifolds, proper
holomorphic mappings to Riemann surfaces, and the Bochner-Hartogs dichotomy
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Xiaofeng Sun
Kähler geometry, Fano manifolds, Hodge Laplacians and deformation/Kuranishi families. [s7] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Hodge Laplacian and geometry of Kuranishi family of Fano manifolds
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Huai-Dong Cao
Geometric analysis and Ricci solitons; adjacent Kähler-Ricci/Fano interests, with recent curvature-classification
research. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Four-dimensional gradient Ricci solitons with (half) nonnegative isotropic curvature
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Representation theory
Angela Hicks
Algebraic combinatorics and noncommutative symmetric functions. [s7] [s13]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · A Combinatorial Perspective on the Noncommutative Symmetric Functions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Mark Skandera
Hecke algebra characters, Kazhdan-Lusztig theory, quantum-group canonical bases and total nonnegativity.
[s7] [s14]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 submitted · On Kazhdan-Lusztig basis elements having no reversal factorization
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

English and GRE
English requirement [Unresolved]
English proficiency is required unless exempt. Tests must remain valid through I-20 processing; submit an
unofficial score report or test documentation, not merely typed scores, with official results after admission. PTE
is accepted beginning 2027. CAS links a 2027 PDF for exact minimums; its content did not render publicly in
this review, so thresholds remain unresolved. [s3] [s4] [s15]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
The university exemption covers a degree earned by enrollment at a US institution with at least two
consecutive years of in-person study; a separate route covers two consecutive years of English-country
study/work in the preceding five years. Your UChicago degree therefore appears eligible if those duration/mode
conditions hold, including pending conferral before enrollment. This is an inference from the published
conditions, subject to CAS review. [s4]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional for 2027 and 2028 CAS applicants except History. Mathematics FAQ recommends General GRE, so
optional does not mean irrelevant. [s1] [s2]
